title: tricyrtis formosana var. stolonifera
intro: Tricyrtis formosana var. stolonifera, commonly known as Formosan Toad Lily, is a type of flowering plant in the family Colchicaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tricyrtis formosana var. stolonifera include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and acting as an expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
